statement: A planet with 5 or more Bindus in the sign it occupies is considered strong by Ashtakavarga's own-sign measure — well-supported results, reinforcing (or, if its sign dignity is weak, partially offsetting) its placement by sign lordship alone.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
